newsitem.title: GERMANY: GERMAN UNION STEPS UP UPS STRIKE SUPPORT.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN UNION STEPS UP UPS STRIKE SUPPORT.

text.p: German transport union OeTV said it was stepping up support for the Teamsters strike at United Parcel Service of America Inc.
Teamsters officials were due to address an OeTV meeting of several hundred UPS employees in Mainz on Wednesday at 6.30 pm (16:30 GMT).
OeTV secretary Heinz Luksch told Reuters the U.S. union representatives would then meet with OeTV officials on Thursday to discuss further steps.
Teamsters officials distributed leaflets to workers outside the UPS handling centre at Cologne airport on Tuesday night, he added.
Luksch said the union had been prevented from using a UPS canteen and an airport restaurant earlier in the day after permission for meetings was withdrawn.
No UPS spokesman was immediately available for comment on the developments.
